claim: An agent was asked to research who Ada Lovelace was and trace her work to the machine it was written for. Someone watching should believe DemoKit carried out that whole research trail on real Wikipedia - searched, opened the article, then followed the citations from Lovelace to Babbage to the Analytical Engine to the Difference Engine - and that every page it claimed to reach is the page it actually landed on.
_ledger: S0  Wikipedia's front page                                   <- where the viewer starts
S1  suggestions for Ada Lovelace                             <- type the query
S2  the Ada Lovelace article                                 <- Enter
S3  Charles Babbage, her collaborator                        <- follow the link
S4  the Analytical Engine he designed                        <- follow the link
S5  the Difference Engine that came before it                <- follow the link
